symptom_heard: harsh, piercing, fatiguing — two raw square voices fighting
root_cause: raw square/sawtooth with no low-pass softening + busy relentless lines
avoid_rule: filter raw waveforms (lpf) or use triangle/filtered-saw for melodic voices; never stack two un-filtered squares as the main texture
evidence: chiptune 'Ironwood Run' rated worst by human ear 2026-05-18

symptom_heard: kick anemic, no low-end punch, buried in the mix
root_cause: kick gain too low relative to synths and/or no dedicated low-end space
avoid_rule: kick must sit clearly above synths (gain ~0.85-1.0); carve sub space; don't let bass+pad mask it
evidence: Gemini heard this on Amber Hours render 2026-05-18

root_cause: relentless note grids with no rests/space; every bar identical
avoid_rule: leave rests; vary bars via <...>; give the lead phrasing space — density is not energy
evidence: early demos 难听; chiptune busy lead

symptom_heard: harmonically dead, droning bass, nothing in key together
root_cause: bass as a held chord-root / no rhythm; layers picking pitches independently
avoid_rule: bass MUST be a rhythmic scale-degree pattern locked to the kick; all pitched layers via one scale-helper for coherence

symptom_heard: technically-correct but unpleasant; niche aesthetic backfires
root_cause: choosing genre by verifiability/nativeness instead of listenability; niche/harsh styles need taste the system lacks
avoid_rule: lean into canonical formula-rich forms (deep house, synthpop, lo-fi, ambient, trance; axis/4-chord progressions) + warm consonant timbres; avoid chiptune/noise/harsh-experimental
evidence: I–vi–IV–V house best, chiptune worst, human verdict 2026-05-18

symptom_heard: a wall of sound, everything fighting the same space, muddy + harsh digital distortion masking the melody
root_cause: hard-clip applied to every layer at once for 'grit' with no headroom or frequency pockets
avoid_rule: do NOT .clip() every layer; clip is rare deliberate grit on ONE element only; create space via gain balance + lpf/hpf carving + rests, not clipping
evidence: Gemini self-heard its own round-1, scored 4/10, 2026-05-18

symptom_heard: loop stalls — revision breaks the render entirely
root_cause: critique proposes fixes outside the renderable palette (sidechain/EQ/compression) so the rewrite uses unsupported constructs
avoid_rule: fixes MUST use only the offline palette: for space/separation use gain balance + lpf/hpf carving + rests + mask; sidechain/EQ/compressor DO NOT EXIST here; revise = minimal edit of the last code that rendered
evidence: producer-brain rounds 2-4 render-failed after a sidechain-proposing critique 2026-05-18

symptom_heard: muddy, no element cuts through — whole mix is dull/dark
root_cause: low-pass filtering applied to chords AND bass AND lead at once; nothing left bright
avoid_rule: keep at least one melodic element bright (lead lpf >= 2500 or unfiltered); never low-pass every pitched layer

symptom_heard: hi-hats thin, harsh, brittle — like a telephone
avoid_rule: hi-hat hpf in ~1500-4000Hz range; do NOT hpf percussion above ~4kHz unless deliberately lo-fi

symptom_heard: kick buries the bass / kick lacks punch — they fight in the low end (RECURRING, the 6/10 plateau)
root_cause: kick and bass occupy the same sub frequencies; the palette has NO sidechain/EQ so the usual fix is unavailable
avoid_rule: TECHNIQUE (palette-bound kick/bass separation, use one): (a) hpf the bass ~120-160Hz so the kick owns the sub; OR (b) rest the bass pattern ON the kick downbeats (e.g. bass on the off-beats / ~ where bd hits); OR (c) rhythmic gain-duck the bass via .gain("<0.05 0.35 0.05 0.35>") synced to the kick. Never propose sidechain/compressor/EQ — they do not exist here.
evidence: Gemini repeatedly proposed sidechain (unavailable) and plateaued at 6/10; this is the taught fix
